title: Peter John Ramos
wikitext:
'''Peter John Ramos''' (b. 1985) is a basketball player from [[Puerto Rico]]. He was born in New York and began playing basketball in the streets of this city. Ramos began capturing the attention of basketball scouts because of his height; he was 6'8" when he was only 15 years old.
===================================================================================
[[Image:Ramos01.gif]]
===================================================================================

Félix Rivera, owner of the [[Criollos de Caguas]] in the [[Puerto Rican Basketball League]] decided to recruit Ramos and bring him to [[Puerto Rico]], despite the fact he had not seen him play [[basketball]]. Ramos met members of his family when he came back to [[Caguas]] and he began studies at the [[Colegio Bautista]]. Under the guidance of coach [[Leonel Arril]], Ramos began learning the keys of the basketball game. Ramos continued getting taller, and by 2004 he was already 7'3". He led his High School to two National Championships. On the [[Puerto Rican Basketball League]], Ramos developed quickly and in 2002 won the ''Most Imporved Player'' Award. In 2003 he earned a spot in the [[Puerto Rican National Team]] and participated in the [[Pan Am Games.]]

In April 2004 Ramos anounced he would enter the 2004 [[NBA Draft]]. Currently Ramos is practicing in several Rookie Camps in the United States and he is expected to be a high pick in the upcoming Draft. If so, he would be the first puertorican to be drafted directly from High School.
